build_grid_search_custom_refit: build a GridSearchCV pipeline with a custom refit callable that selects the simplest model within one standard deviation of the best score
create_lower_bound_function: create a lower_bound function that calculates the threshold as best mean test score minus one standard deviation from GridSearchCV results
create_best_low_complexity_function: create a best_low_complexity function that selects the model with fewest PCA components whose score is within one standard deviation of the best
run_pipeline_hyperparameter_search: run a Pipeline with PCA dimensionality reduction and LogisticRegression classification using GridSearchCV over multiple PCA component counts
visualize_cv_results_bar_chart: visualize cross-validated test and train scores with error bands and highlight the selected model from one-standard-error rule
